CustomField.description: When this activity/status entry occurred in Yardi. Mirrored read-only from the Yardi sync; orders the append-only Work Order Activity timeline, where same-transaction rows share a timestamp and tie-break on Name. Replaces Entry_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time the activity occurred in Yardi. Mirrored read-only from the sync - do not edit it in Salesforce; the timeline is ordered newest-first by this value.
CustomField.label: Entry DateTime
